status: predeclared replacements; not reconstructions of the lost numerical instances
anti_tuning_rule: Each instance is generated once from the rules below. No seed, coefficient, threshold, horizon, or query set may be changed in response to CVaR, margin, allocation ratio, or MSE results. Any future change requires a new instance name and version.

controlled_untied_v1.generator: numpy.random.default_rng (PCG64), with NumPy pinned by requirements-lock.txt
controlled_untied_v1.draw_order: h=1,...,5; state=0,...,4; reward Dirichlet then transition Dirichlet
controlled_untied_v1.joint_law: independent product of the drawn reward and successor probability vectors
controlled_untied_v1.query_groups: (5,0), plus every (h,s) for h=1,...,4 and s=0,...,4; 21 total

inventory_untied_v1.demand_censoring: values 0,...,5 retain Poisson mass and value 6 receives P(D>=6)
inventory_untied_v1.event_order: order to base stock subject to capacity, observe demand, then observe disruption
inventory_untied_v1.disruption: probability 0.08 at post-order stock 6 and 0.06 otherwise; removes one remaining unit and lowers reward one category
inventory_untied_v1.quantization: profit<=2 gives 0; 2<profit<8 gives 0.5; profit>=8 gives 1; disruption subtracts 0.5 with floor 0
inventory_untied_v1.query_groups: all positive-probability reachable (h,s) from root (8,0); derived mechanically, never selected by result quality
